content: Man has the capacity to rise above his biological, psychological, and sociological conditions—and to defy them.
author: Viktor Frankl
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Viktor Frankl understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
